suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

suggested_services.name: First nutrition visit
suggested_services.example: The main story: Alex's first nutrition visit with Grace, Sat Oct 24 at 11:00am, with a doctor's referral. Nothing is taken and no card is saved. The desk checks Willow Health and logs the referral, and Alex pays the $35 share at the front desk. Self-pay clients pay $150, then $90 a follow-up, the same way.

suggested_services.name: First nutrition visit
suggested_services.example: The same first visit where Sam turns on the clinic's $40 late-cancel fee. A card is saved for it, never for a fee-free client, and Sam confirms any charge. Alex still pays at the front desk.

suggested_services.name: First nutrition visit
suggested_services.example: The same first visit on a Saturday morning, when nobody is at the front desk (video visits work the same). Nothing is taken, and Rosie texts Alex the bill when Grace texts DONE.

suggested_services.name: Home nutrition visit
suggested_services.example: The main story: Alex, who can't easily get out for now, has a $179 home nutrition visit with Marcus, Thu Oct 22 at 8:00am, with a look at the kitchen. Alex pays out of pocket: nothing is taken, no card is saved, and Rosie texts the bill when Marcus texts DONE. Grocery store tours ($75) are paid the same way.

suggested_services.name: Home nutrition visit
suggested_services.example: The same home visit when Alex's health plan pays in network, with a doctor's referral. Nothing is taken, and Lee Home Nutrition bills the plan its own way.

before_times: for you (18 or older), or for your child or teen (a parent or guardian books and comes)
which state you'll be in during the visit (a dietitian must be licensed there, by video too)
a health plan (its name only), or paying yourself
has a doctor sent a referral: yes, not yet, or no
at the clinic, by video, or at your home (the town, for a home visit or a store tour)
after_time: anything that helps at the visit, like an interpreter or a step-free door
at home: parking, pets, and who else will be home
for a grocery store tour: which store
secure_page_only: the plan's member ID and photos of the plan card
the referring doctor's name and practice
the intake: health conditions, medicines and supplements, allergies and intolerances, height and weight, recent lab results, and eating history and habits
for video: where you'll be, and an emergency contact
whether texts and voicemail are safe, and what a message may say
a child's details, and the parent's or guardian's consent
intake_questions.never_asked: the condition, weight, lab results, medicine names, eating habits and a child's details are never asked in the AI chat or by text: only on the secure page
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18, who comes to the visit (the owner OKs it first); a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent; someone else may pay, but the client agrees for themselves

stop.words: a medical emergency: fainting, confusion, chest pain, trouble breathing, or very high or very low blood sugar the person can't bring back
stop.say: This sounds like an emergency. Call 911 now. Don't wait for an appointment.
If you're thinking about harming yourself, call or text 988 now. If you're in danger right now, call 911.
stop.booking: no booking in that chat; if the person is already a client, the owner and their dietitian are told at once with a link, never the words

stop.words: signs of an eating disorder: making yourself throw up, using laxatives to get rid of food, going days without eating, or a strong fear of gaining weight
stop.say: The clinic's own team books this kind of care by phone, together with your doctor. Please also talk with your doctor soon. If you feel faint or unwell now, call 911. If you have thoughts of hurting yourself, call or text 988.
stop.booking: no booking by the AI: the clinic's own line, and no weight-loss or meal-plan visit is offered; the owner is told with a link, never the words

go_on.words: feeling unwell, or a sugar reading that worries them, with nothing above
go_on.what: Rosie says to call their doctor today, and 911 if it gets worse; then booking goes on

go_on.words: a question about food, weight or medicine
go_on.what: no advice from Rosie or the AI: the dietitian answers at the visit, or on the secure page; nothing is quoted in a text

safety_and_stop_words.always: the general screen on every message, call and intake answer: danger to life or a medical emergency gets 911, self-harm gets 988; Rosie never gives diet, weight or medical advice, only booking

steps.name: Doctor's referral
steps.when: where the client's plan pays for nutrition therapy only with a doctor's referral (often only for some conditions), or where the state's form requires one (a switch); due 2 business days before the visit, so the client hears before free cancel ends
steps.who: clients whose plan or state asks for it
steps.result: the desk logs it when the doctor's practice sends it; not in by the due time: the desk calls the doctor's practice; still missing: the client hears the plan may not pay, and keeps it at self-pay, moves it, or cancels free

steps.name: Intake on the secure page
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due the day before; one reminder
steps.who: every client, and each adult in a family visit
steps.result: not done: the owner keeps the visit (filled in before it starts), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the desk, by hand or an electronic check
steps.who: every client who names a plan
steps.result: covered (the share shows), covered only for some conditions or with a referral, not covered (self-pay, or a free cancel), or can't check now (the desk checks by the next business day)

steps.name: Intro call
steps.when: before the first visit, at least a day before; booked with it on one secure link
steps.who: a new client who asks for one
steps.result: a fit: the first visit stands; another dietitian fits better: the client OKs the change; not a fit: cancelled with nothing charged

steps.name: A written good-faith estimate
steps.when: told while booking; sent on time, as the federal rules say
steps.result: a to-do for the desk, with its due date; Rosie delivers it and records when

steps.name: Recent lab results
steps.when: on the secure page, if the client has them
steps.result: never a reason to hold up a visit

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for a first visit: the medicines and supplements on the secure page, and recent lab results if there are any; for video: a quiet, private place; for a home visit: the kitchen as it usually is; for a grocery store tour: meet at the store's entrance

staff.skills: who sees adults, teens and families; who offers video, home visits and grocery store tours; who speaks which language; who is trained for eating-disorder care (booked only by the clinic's team, by phone); a dietitian with a provisional license works under a supervisor
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each dietitian's own license per state, or their registration where a state's form has no license; a diabetes educator's certificate for diabetes education
staff.supervision: a dietitian with a provisional license works only under the supervisor the state's form sets (a switch)
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs visits for anyone under 18, same-day visits, any custom price, and anything a dietitian flags
staff.stand_in: a client's dietitian is never changed without the client's own yes; a stand-in is offered only with the same license for the client's state and the same skills

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18, who comes to the visit (the owner OKs it first); a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent; someone else may pay, but the client agrees for themselves
children_and_age.minors_texts: texts about a child's or teen's visit go to the parent or guardian
children_and_age.minors_rules: who may consent for a child or teen (switches from the state's form)

visit.check_in: at the clinic: the code at the front desk; by video: read out at the start; at home: the code at the door; a grocery store tour: the code at the store's entrance
visit.done: the code or DONE; visit notes, goals and any meal plan stay in the practice's own record and on the secure page, never in a text; Rosie keeps only booking notes
visit.changes_at_visit: nothing is added during a visit; a longer visit is booked ahead; the dietitian sets the goals with the client at the visit (never Rosie), and the follow-ups agreed there are confirmed by the client's own yes by text
visit.before_work: the dietitian reads the intake; at a video visit, the dietitian confirms the client's name and where they are, for the license and in case of an emergency

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: always for medical nutrition therapy: a dietitian's own license where the state's form licenses dietitians, or the national dietitian registration (RDN) as the proof where the state's form has no license (a switch)
license.who: each person; the practice too, only where the state's form registers nutrition practices (a switch)
license.ask: each dietitian's license number and state, and their registration number, in the invite reply (or the owner sends them); a diabetes educator's certificate number for diabetes education
license.insurance: malpractice insurance where the state's form or a plan asks for it

never_in_a_text: client texts carry only the business name, the date, the time, the place and a secure link: never the kind of visit, a condition, a weight, lab results, a medicine name, food or eating details, or a child's details; at home and at a store, the dietitian's name and photo stay, for the door check; the video link stays on the secure page
